independentReview.required: Independent teacher review and learner evidence; this editorial inspection is not approval.

method: Read official SCSA web-rendered Year11 teaching-from-2026 PDF unit content printed pp8–18, then inspected local chapter explanations, worked code, depth manifest and named workbooks. Groups use meaningful common demands, with exact leaf locators. Supported means resource evidence exists; it does not certify student achievement, delivery timing, formal assessment coverage, legal currency or independent approval.
